approval: Repository owner decision of 2026-11-18: the comparator may be extended only through a written amendment recorded before execution, naming each added capability and why it does not loosen the criteria, followed by a rerun of all 36 scenarios

capabilities.name: child fibers mounted from a parent body, structural ownership and teardown join
effects with bodies and async/control/catch metadata
intercept contexts, NeedWith, service and available provision modes
ownership proof for an output cell shared across realms
more than one provider of one address, by refusal or swap, refusal error text compared by class

outOfScope.errorText: only the duplicate-provision refusal message of C6.5 is compared by class; all other error text is compared verbatim
